answer: One defense is a costly identity bond with correlated slashing. Each agent locks collateral behind a persistent key, and auditors map funding paths before an identity counts. Launching a thousand sybils then means financing a thousand separate bonds: an attacker must cross a narrow ridge of real capital with no shared treasury, and any linked cluster is slashed as one. Like a canyon that channels every tributary into one exposed stream, the ledger makes common funding visible, so a lotus of fake accounts cannot float free of the bond anchoring it. The barrier is capital at risk, not compute.
